blocks.p: Merrivoss Bioanalysis is pleased to provide this proposal for the work described below. Matrix, species and analytical limits for each assay are given in Section 3. This proposal responds to the request from Avernelwick Pharma for work on 40 compounds from the Avernelwick aminopyrimidine regioisomer test article set.
Reference: MV-2018-052. Prepared by Dr M. Larkin, DMPK Study Director.
40 compounds, to be supplied by Avernelwick Pharma as 10 mM DMSO solutions (minimum 40 µL each) in a single accession lot.

list: Microsomal CLint: human and rat liver microsomes, 1 µM, five time points
fu,p by equilibrium dialysis: human plasma, rapid equilibrium dialysis with recovery

blocks.p: The work will follow our standard procedures, summarized below. Any deviation will be agreed with the client before testing.

Test articles (1 µM) will be incubated with pooled human and rat liver microsomes (0.5 mg/mL protein) at 37 °C with NADPH (1 mM); a no-NADPH control at 45 minutes checks for non-metabolic loss. Samples at 0, 5, 15, 30 and 45 minutes are quenched in acetonitrile with internal standard and analyzed by LC-MS/MS. CLint is calculated from the first-order depletion slope. When depletion over 45 minutes is below the quantifiable limit, CLint is reported as an upper bound (<3 µL/min/mg) and half-life as a lower bound (>60 min).
Matrix acceptance: verapamil (high clearance) and diltiazem (moderate clearance) within 0.5-2 times their historical CLint in each run; no-NADPH loss below 15%.

Binding to human plasma will be measured by rapid equilibrium dialysis (5 µM test article, 4 h at 37 °C, PBS pH 7.4). Plasma and buffer compartments are matrix-matched before LC-MS/MS. Results are reported as percent bound and percent unbound with mass-balance recovery; recoveries below 70% are footnoted.
Warfarin is included as the binding control in every plate (acceptance: 97-99.5% bound).

list: Results workbook (assay worksheets with compound-level data, control results and a study summary sheet)
Final report (PDF) with methods, control results and interpretation
Raw traces and instrument files on request

blocks.p: Draft results within 5 weeks of receipt of test articles. Work starts once compounds and a purchase order are received; we will confirm the start date on receipt.

list: Quotation valid for 90 days from the date above
Invoiced in full on issue of the final report; payment within 30 days
Unused compound returned or destroyed at the client's instruction
Data and samples retained for 5 years
